Physical_Environment.Location: Henan University, School of Psychology, Kaifeng, China (laboratory rooms; participants tested individually)

Experimental_Design.Conditions: 2 (group: matching-first, nonmatching-first) × 3 (consistency: matching, nonmatching, filler) × 2 (identity: self, other) × 9 (phase: baseline, training 1-7, formal test), mixed design; group between-subjects, consistency/identity/phase within-subjects

Block_Structure.Block_number: 4 practice blocks , 2 formal blocks; 9 phases total: baseline, training 1-7, formal test
Block_Structure.Trial_number: Practice: 4 blocks × 10 trials = 40 trials; Formal: 2 blocks × 80 trials per condition

Stimulus_Properties.Label: Self, Other (自我、他人); Filler: 白栽, 地入 (pseudowords referencing self/other in character structure)

exp1.detail: Experiment adapted from Sui et al. (2012). 26 university students participated (matching-first group: 14, 11M/3F; nonmatching-first group: 12, 10M/2F). IRB approved by Henan University School of Psychology. E-Prime software on 1024×768 monitor at 85 Hz, viewing distance ~57 cm. Mixed design: 2 (group: matching-first/nonmatching-first, between-subjects) × 3 (consistency: matching/nonmatching/filler, within) × 2 (identity: self/other, within) × 9 (phase: baseline, training 1-7, formal test, within). Task: learn shape-label associations (square/circle with self/other), then judge if shape-label pair matches learned association. Matching trials: consistent pairing; Nonmatching trials: inconsistent pairing; Filler trials: neutral pseudowords (白栽, 地入) referencing self/other in character structure. Training manipulation: matching-first group attends to matching trials during training 1-7; nonmatching-first group attends to nonmatching trials. 9 phases: baseline, 7 training blocks, formal test. Practice: 4 blocks × 10 trials. Formal: 2 blocks × 80 trials per condition. Stimulus duration 100 ms, ITI 1200 ms, feedback 500 ms. Response keys: p, o (from config.py). Shape visual angle 3.8°, fixation 0.8°, text 2.4°×1.6°, interval 3.5°.
